svg.aria-label: Understanding and Mitigating Inference-Time Overreliance Using Agentic Memory — arXiv:2610.07311
svg.title: Understanding and Mitigating Inference-Time Overreliance Using Agentic Memory — arXiv:2610.07311
svg.text: Retrieved memories can distort an agent's inference even when they are benign,
correctly stored and appropriately retrieved. We name this memory over-reliance
and show it is strongest under partial query-memory overlap. MEMTRIM indexes
evidence at write time and controls its reuse at read time, cutting over-reliance
while keeping the benefits of useful memory.
